notes:
I couldn't write these notes. When I tried to open the sources, the research tool said I had no calls left for this turn, so I wasn't able to read any of the pages. That includes Enduring Word, Gill, Ellicott, the Pulpit Commentary, Precept Austin, NET Bible notes, Wesley, Spurgeon's *Treasury of David* and Augustine on New Advent.

Your rules say to report only what the pages say, cite a URL for every point and not fill gaps from my own knowledge. Without the pages, anything I wrote would come from memory, and I can't stand behind those links. So I've left out all the commentary rather than give you something unsourced.

These are the pages I tried to open. They're the places to start once I can search again:
- Enduring Word: https://enduringword.com/bible-commentary/psalm-97/
- Gill: https://biblehub.com/commentaries/gill/psalms/97.htm
- Ellicott: https://biblehub.com/commentaries/ellicott/psalms/97.htm
- Pulpit Commentary: https://biblehub.com/commentaries/pulpit/psalms/97.htm
- Wesley's notes: https://biblehub.com/commentaries/wesley/psalms/97.htm
- Spurgeon, *Treasury of David*: https://www.studylight.org/commentaries/eng/tod/psalms-97.html
- Precept Austin: https://www.preceptaustin.org/psalm-97-commentary
- NET Bible notes: https://netbible.org/bible/Psalms+97
- Augustine on the Psalms (his numbering, from the Latin Bible, calls this Psalm 96): https://www.newadvent.org/fathers/1801097.htm

If you ask again in a new message, I'll read these pages and send the verse-by-verse notes in the format you asked for.
